notes: Tier+Tactical Medical (Kai). Its two preferences are server settings the host changes in the Admin menu's Add-On Settings, off by default as Kai had them: Can Heal Bots, and Teams Can Heal Enemies. Medics heal players (bots too with Can Heal Bots); in a minigame only players in theirs, and with teams (Slayer's) only their own team or an allied one unless Teams Can Heal Enemies is on; outside minigames only on a single-player or LAN game, to players in no minigame, or with Can Heal Bots their own bots. The Gauze Gun's needle heals whoever it hits at once and leaves them its heal over time, which a hit, an emote or flames end early as they replace it on the body. The Syringe heals its holder, then needs to recharge, saying so when it is back; jet throws it at someone close for a bigger heal. The heal cross bursts only on someone hurt by at least the heal.

handles.TT_defaultIfUnset: never runs: it is the fallback for a server without RTB, and here the copy's RTB_registerPref calls are server settings
handles.call:TT_defaultIfUnset: never runs: it is the fallback for a server without RTB, and here the copy's RTB_registerPref calls are server settings
handles.Armor::onTrigger: engine image commands: jet with the Syringe in hand runs its onAltTrigger (the host rules' throws table)
handles.TT_canHeal: the host rules' can_heal: players, and bots with MedicHealBots on; in a minigame the healer's own, and with teams (Slayer's) only the healer's team or an allied one (Ally Same Colour) unless MedicHealEnemy is on, a healer on no team healing anyone; outside minigames on a single-player or LAN game (`lan()`) a player in none, or with MedicHealBots on the healer's own bots
handles.TT_projectileHeal: the host rules' on_projectile_hit: the heals table's burst, the cross on anyone hurt by at least it, both bottom prints and the heal image on the body (engine `emote`)
handles.medigunProjectile::onCollision: the host rules' heals table (its TT_projectileHeal burst); the needle's own hit and push as any projectile's
handles.stimpackProjectile::onCollision: the host rules' heals table (its TT_projectileHeal burst)
handles.medigunHealImage::onMount: the host rules start the heal count from 0 as they put the image on
handles.medigunHealImage::onHeal: engine emote slot: the image's onHeal state runs the host rules' heal_tick, which heals the wearer while alive and takes the image off after its count (the over_time table)
handles.medigunImage::onFire: the image's Fire state: the arm's plant and the shot sound, then its needle as any gun's
handles.stimpackImage::onFire: the host rules' stim (the syringes table): the recharge wait and its centre print, the arm, sound, cross and heal image when hurt enough, the heal, and the recharge notice
handles.stimRechargedNotice: the host rules' on_tick: the notice's centre print and sound, to the same living body
handles.stimpackImage::onAltTrigger: the host rules' stim_throw (the throws table): the arm, sound and the thrown syringe from the muzzle

prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::MedicHealBots: medics heal bots too, and their own bots outside minigames (can_heal)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::MedicHealEnemy: in a minigame with teams, medics heal other teams' players too (can_heal)
